question: Where can I get a list of active mines and quarries in Germany, with location, mineral or rock extracted, operator and annual production?

answer.summary: No nationwide public register of active mines and quarries was found. Hessen, Bavaria, Baden-Württemberg, Brandenburg and some Lower Rhine districts publish site records with varying attributes and status definitions. Hessen’s 276 records include a planned site and provide operators and output classes. No annual production figures per site were verified.
main_caveats: 'Active' differs by source: BW 'in Betrieb' layer includes 'Abbau ruht' and 'in Herrichtung'; Saxony MR.Mine 'operating' covers closure plans (Abschlussbetriebsplan); BY status is from the last aerial photo.
Mining-authority layers cover only BBergG sites; most gravel, sand, limestone and natural-stone quarries fall under Land/district permits and appear only in geological-survey or district layers.

The sources checked did not provide actual annual production per site. Hessen provides output classes without a reference year. USGS capacity and planned extraction in permits describe different measures.
BGR KOR250 'Abbaustelle' points are from map sheets of 1989-2024 and often mark the company seat; BSK1000 still shows mines closed by 2018.
Coverage is uneven: structured site layers were found for 5 of 16 Länder plus 3 NRW districts; national aggregates (BGR, SdK) are not site lists.
answer.confidence_reason: Each Land checked with services queried; MV and Sachsen-Anhalt could not be inspected, city-states not checked, and GEM/OSM could not be tested from this environment.

attributes.note: Exact points/polygons for active sites in BW, BY, HE, BB, SN (mining plans) and 3 NRW districts; KOR250 national points are 1989-2024 map vintages.
attributes.gap_note: No public site layer found for NI (PDF map only), RP, TH, SH, SL or most of NRW; Sachsen-Anhalt portal returns 403 to automated clients and the MV map portal did not respond.

attributes.note: Raw material per active site in BW (Rohstoff), BY (rohst_rgs), HE (ROHSTOFF), BB (bodenschatz), NRW districts; Saxony MR.Mine has none.
attributes.gap_note: Same Länder gaps as location; mining-rights layers (NI LBEG, RP LGB) give licensed commodities, not extraction.

attributes.note: Operator field only in Hessen (FIRMA, 276/276), Brandenburg (unternehmer, 241/241) and KRZN NRW districts (FIRMA); USGS names operators of major facilities.
attributes.gap_note: No operator field in BW, BY, Saxony MR.Mine or KOR250 layers checked; LBEG company directory (2016) links firms to districts, not sites.

attributes.note: Only Hessen publishes a per-site output class (e.g. '> 50.000 — 250.000 t/a', year not stated); GEM's lignite mine output could not be tested.
attributes.gap_note: BBergG operators report Rohförderung per Betrieb to mining authorities (§§ 67, 70) and Destatis keeps Einzelangaben secret (§ 16 BStatG); only Land/national totals are published.

exclusions.value: No operator in BW or BY; BY status is not the permitted state; BW underground sites are centroids supplied by the mining authority; BW polygons only from 0.5 ha.
exclusions.quote: Die Ausdehnung der Flächen und der Betriebszustand der Abbaustellen spiegeln den Zustand zum Aufnahmezeitpunkt des letzten Luftbildes wider und stellen nicht den tagesaktuellen und/oder tatsächlich genehmigten Zustand dar.

key_fields.meaning: Operator company (Hessen layer 3; KRZN layers).
Extraction-site name (Hessen).
Raw material and raw-material group extracted (Hessen; KRZN uses ROHSTOFF).
Annual output class in t/a (Hessen only).
Legal basis of extraction (BBergG, Baurecht, BImSchG, Wasserrecht) – Hessen.
BW site status: in Betrieb, zeitweise in Betrieb, Abbau ruht, in Herrichtung.
BY activity state at last aerial photo and the photo year.
BY raw materials 1-3 extracted.

steps: Hessen: query layer 3 with where=1=1&outFields=*&f=json&outSR=4326 (276 records, under the 2,000-record limit); layer 1 holds the same 276 sites.

Baden-Württemberg: WFS 2.0 GetFeature TYPENAMES=ms:roh_rgdb_1_a (surface) and ms:roh_rgdb_2_a (underground); coordinates EPSG:25832; filter Status to 'in Betrieb'/'zeitweise in Betrieb' if paused sites must be excluded.
Bayern: download the GeoPackage with GET, read table rohstoff_gwst_ag (sqlite3) and keep l_sl_betriebszustand = 'in Abbau befindlich' (1,299 of 12,177); polygons in rohstoff_gwst_gwfl.
NRW Lower Rhine: WFS 1.1.0 GetFeature typeName=gis:kkle_abgrabung_inbetrieb, gis:kvie_abgrabung_inbetrieb, gis:kwes_abgrabung_inbetrieb (98 polygons).
Harmonise raw-material vocabularies per Land and keep the Land of origin; there is no common national code list.
reading_traps: BW 'in Betrieb' layers are not strictly operating: of 530 surface points, 94 'Abbau ruht' and 8 'in Herrichtung'.
BY GeoPackage table identifiers read 'Gewinnungsstellen (inaktiv)' although they contain both states; filter on l_sl_betriebszustand.
BY download URL answers 404 to HEAD requests but 200 to GET.
Hessen FOERDERUNG is a class, not a figure, and has no year; one record is 'Tagebau (geplant)'. HLNUG's 2025 leaflet speaks of 247 Gewinnungsstellen while the layer has 276 points.
KRZN STAND_DER_DATEN can be years old (e.g. 06.07.2012) even in the 'inbetrieb' layer.

problems: Coverage limited to the Länder and districts listed as members; no national harmonisation.
Hessen and LGRB services state no open licence in their capabilities.

evidence.quote: Aktive Abbaustellen (auch Gewinnungsstellen genannt) mineralischer Rohstoffe in Hessen mit Zuordnung der abgebauten Rohstoffe und ihrer Fördermengenklassen.

evidence.claim: Hessen layer 3 includes annual output classes
evidence.quote: Industrieller Einsatz von Rohstoffen in aktiven Abbaustellen und Information über die Jahresfördermenge in Form der Zuordnung zu Förderklassen.
Das Thema „Rohstoffgewinnung“ stellt historische und aktuelle Abbaustellen dar, welche durch die Gewinnungsflächen näher bestimmt werden.

Grundlage der Daten zur Rohstoffgewinnung sind die wirtschaftsgeologischen Informationen aus den Betriebserhebungen des Referats Landesrohstoffgeologie, die rohstoffgeologische Kartierung und die Stellungnahmen im Rahmen der Anhörung der Träger öffentlicher Belange.

regulator.name: Mining authorities of the Länder (Bergbehörden) for BBergG sites; Land and district permit authorities (Abgrabung, BImSchG, water law) for other quarries

operators.note: Hundreds of companies: >760 crushed-stone quarries alone (BGR 2026); lignite by RWE, LEAG, MIBRAG and Romonta; potash by K+S. No national census of operators; LBEG publishes a 2016 company directory for Niedersachsen.

publication_obligation.norm: Reporting (not publication): BBergG §§ 67 and 70 (1) with UnterlagenBergV § 9 (employees and Fördermengen); ProdGewStatG for statistics (confidential under § 16 BStatG).
publication_obligation.what_must_be_published: Nothing found; operators under mining law report Rohförderung and verwertbare Förderung per operation to the mining authority each year.
publication_obligation.frequency: Annual report to the mining authority by end of February.

consolidated_republication.note: Mining authorities aggregate per-operation data by Land for the BMWE; the federal 'Der Bergbau in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland' ended with 2016 data and BGR now republishes only totals.

checked_pages.saw: States there is no single source of production data and that the BMWi documentation was discontinued (last data 2016); totals only.
Annual statistical survey form: Rohförderung and verwertbare Förderung per Betriebsnummer under BBergG §§ 67, 70.
Annual report 'Der Bergbau in Sachsen' archived only up to 2015.
2025 annual report with production by commodity and number of operations; named sites only for single-operation commodities.
Production surveys with 20 (or 10) employee thresholds; individual returns kept secret.

checked_pages.organization: LBEG (mining authority for NI, SH, HH, HB)
checked_pages.saw: Receives operators' statistical returns on employees and Fördermengen under §§ 9-10 UnterlagenBergV; no publication of site data.

national_registry.note: No national register of active mines and quarries found; responsibility lies with Land mining authorities and, for most quarries, Land/district permit authorities. The only national point layer (BGR KOR250) is a map compilation of 1989-2024.

checked_pages.saw: 'gibt es in Deutschland auch keine einheitliche Quelle für Daten zur Rohstoffproduktion'.
KOR250 'Abbaustellen' active at the time of each map sheet, 1989-2024.
BBergG executed by Länder mining authorities; no national list.
Statistical returns confidential; aggregate tables only.
Only Land datasets (Bayern, Sachsen KOR50) for extraction sites.
Facilities table of major facilities, sourced partly from BGR; no German register cited.

if_unstructured.summary: Per-site production and, outside a few Länder, operator and location must be taken from documents: mining-authority annual reports, BGR commodity studies, operator websites and permit files.
recipe: Start from the structured Land layers (Hessen, Bayern, Baden-Württemberg, Brandenburg, NRW districts) for location and material.
For Länder without a layer, take named operations from the mining authority's annual report and from BGR studies, and place them with the KOR250 map or the parcel references of permit files.

Take production per site only where a document states it for a single named operation (mining-authority report for single-site commodities, BGR study, operator page); record year and whether it is raw or saleable output.
Keep planned or permitted annual extraction from permit files in a separate column: it is capacity, not production.
if_unstructured.location_method: Permit files give Gemarkung, Flur and Flurstück numbers (e.g. Bad Sülze, Flur 7, Flurstücke 86-87) that can be matched to the Land cadastre; BGR studies give only place names.
if_unstructured.cross_with: Cross operators and site names between the Land layers, the mining-authority establishments (Brandenburg) and the USGS facilities table; check status against the latest aerial-photo year (Bavaria) or the operating-plan type (Brandenburg, Sachsen).

where_published.name: Annual reports of the Land mining authorities (e.g. Bezirksregierung Arnsberg, Abteilung Bergbau und Energie NRW)
where_published.what: Production by raw material and number of operations; when only one or two operations produce a commodity they are named with their output.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Section 'Sonstige Bodenschätze in Nordrhein-Westfalen' (printed p. 18, PDF p. 20 of the 2025 report); no search tool, use PDF text search for the commodity.

example_document.what_it_gives: Printed p. 18: 'Im Berichtszeitraum wurden im Tagebau „Auf dem Kreuz“ mit 14 Beschäftigten 18 600 t Kaolin gefördert'; 'in den zwei Betrieben „Nammen“ und „Wülpker Egge“ der Barbara Erzbergbau GmbH insgesamt 474 471 t Eisenerz'.

where_published.name: BGR commodity studies (e.g. 'Gebrochene Natursteine in Deutschland', 2026)
where_published.what: Quarry-by-quarry descriptions of more than 760 crushed-stone quarries with operator, rock and sometimes annual output; Land totals from mining-authority statistics. The gypsum study (2025) maps the 63 gypsum/anhydrite deposits in extraction in 2024.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Chapters by Land and region; PDF text search for the quarry or company name (264 pages, 39 MB).

example_document.what_it_gives: p. 116: 'Das Werk Lüptitz der Hartsteinwerke Bayern-Mitteldeutschland, einer Zweigniederlassung der Basalt AG … Quarzporphyr'; 'Die Jahresproduktion von 1,0 – 1,2 Mio. t Gesteinskörnungen in Lüptitz'.

where_published.name: Operator websites (lignite and salt mines)
where_published.what: Site pages of large operators with typical annual output ranges.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Site pages per mine on the operator's website.

example_document.what_it_gives: 'Im Dreischichtbetrieb fördert der Tagebau Garzweiler jährlich 20 bis 25 Millionen Tonnen Braunkohle, Tendenz abnehmend.'

where_published.name: UVP-Verbund (environmental impact assessment portal of the Länder)
where_published.what: Framework operating plans (Rahmenbetriebsplan) and permit files of new or extended pits and quarries with operator, parcels and planned extraction.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Full-text search and map by Vorhaben; search 'Kiessandtagebau', 'Steinbruch' or 'Rahmenbetriebsplan'; older documents are often removed (two links found by search returned 404).

example_document.what_it_gives: Title page: 'Vorhabensträger: Kieswerk Langsdorf GmbH c/o Peene Kies GmbH', 'Landkreis: Vorpommern-Rügen'; PDF p. 5: 'plant eine mittlere Jahresförderung von etwa 250.000 bis 300.000 t Rohstoff' (planned, not actual).

related_not_answering.name: BGR – Deutschland – Rohstoffsituation 2024
related_not_answering.why: National production totals by commodity (e.g. gravel/sand 211 Mt, crushed stone 167 Mt in 2024) and lists of lignite/potash mines by operator in text, but no production per site.

related_not_answering.name: Statistik der Kohlenwirtschaft – Produktionszahlen des Braunkohlenbergbaus
related_not_answering.why: Lignite output by mining district (Rheinland, Lausitz, Mitteldeutschland), not by Tagebau; header says '1.000 t' but values are in tonnes.

related_not_answering.name: DEBRIV – Braunkohle Daten und Fakten 2023
related_not_answering.why: Employees, reserves and products by district, no per-mine data.

related_not_answering.name: GD NRW – Abgrabungsmonitoring NRW (Erläuterungsbericht 2023)
related_not_answering.why: Extraction areas and extracted volumes estimated from aerial photos, published only as totals by planning region.

related_not_answering.name: BGR – BSK1000 'Abbaustellen'
related_not_answering.why: 76 points of major mines including hard-coal mines closed by 2018; outdated overview, not an active list.

related_not_answering.name: Mining-rights maps (LBEG Bergaufsicht WMS, LGB RLP Berechtsamskarte, Brandenburg bgberechtig)
related_not_answering.why: Licences (Erlaubnis, Bewilligung, Bergwerkseigentum) show rights, not active extraction.

related_not_answering.name: Bezirksregierung Arnsberg – WMS Bergbauberechtigungen in NRW
related_not_answering.why: Mining-rights fields with holder and mineral (existing and extinguished since 1982), not operating sites.

related_not_answering.name: Raw-material deposit maps (GD NRW RK50, LBEG RSK25, LGB RLP Rohstoffgeologie)
related_not_answering.why: Deposits and safeguarding areas, not extraction sites.

related_not_answering.name: thru.de – PRTR-Gesamtdatenbestand 2007-2024
related_not_answering.why: Only facilities exceeding release thresholds report; for 2024 just 3 underground mines (3(a)) and 3 quarries (3(b)) appear.

related_not_answering.name: Destatis – Produktionserhebungen (Qualitätsbericht)
related_not_answering.why: Production statistics by product with employee thresholds; individual returns are confidential under § 16 BStatG.

related_not_answering.name: LfU Schleswig-Holstein – Rohstoffgewinnung 2020
related_not_answering.why: Voluntary operator survey reported by five economic regions only.

related_not_answering.name: Kieswerk Langsdorf – Rahmenbetriebsplan, 7. Änderung (UVP-Verbund)
related_not_answering.why: Permit documents give operator, parcels and planned annual extraction (250,000-300,000 t), which is not actual production.

open_questions: Hessen: the HLNUG 2025 leaflet counts 247 Gewinnungsstellen while the active-site layer has 276 points; the layer gives no reference date to reconcile them.
Lignite production per Tagebau: GEM cites a 'German statistics report' that could not be identified; Statistik der Kohlenwirtschaft and the NRW mining report publish district totals only.
